description: Native CATPart/CATProduct submission registry (P5-M2 contribution pipeline). Entries here are user/developer-contributed native CATParts, license-noted dev-only, entered through corpus/tools/build_manifest.py and gated by the P1-M1-T06 privacy/ITAR sweep before any byte enters the shared repo or NAS mirror. 2026-10-16 Don posture: corpus is dev-only reference material, never shipped; do NOT over-filter on redistributability (samples that cannot be redistributed are fine for development); the privacy/ITAR sweep stays a hard line.
